headline: Comedian forced to apologize to politician’s pet dog after stage routine deemed 'insufficiently wag-worthy'
body: Following a satirical performance at a political rally, local stand-up artist Ramesh Iyer has been ordered to issue a formal apology to the leader’s golden retriever for failing to include enough canine-friendly punchlines in his set. Party spokespersons stated the omission of the dog's favorite frisbee puns constituted a deliberate attempt to undermine the animal's morale.
caption: When the crowd isn't the only one you have to please, the struggle is real. Who knew four-legged critics were the toughest audience? #ComedyCringe #Politics #PetPolitics (satire)
